query: SELECT lc.id, lc.periodoCustoId, lc.contaCustoId, lc.valor, lc.observacoes, cc.nome as contaNome FROM lancamento_custo lc JOIN conta_custo cc ON lc.contaCustoId = cc.id WHERE lc.observacoes LIKE '%Fluxo%' AND lc.periodoCustoId = (SELECT id FROM periodo_custo WHERE ano = 2026 AND mes = 5 LIMIT 1) ORDER BY lc.contaCustoId;
